newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Serial killer stalks S.Africa's Zulu region -police.
newsitem.headline: Serial killer stalks S.Africa's Zulu region -police.

text.p: South African police believe a serial killer is prowling the country's east coast and has killed at least seven women since February.
The decomposed remains of seven black women aged between 20 and 30 have been found in the Phoenix area on the outskirts of the Indian Ocean port city of Durban, a spokesman said.
"The women were all strangled...it is difficult to establish if they were also raped," Director Bala Naidoo said in a statement.
None of the bodies had yet been identified.
A special unit of seven detectives had been called in on the case -- the second of its kind in KwaZulu-Natal in recent years.
Last month a 23-year-old man was jailed for 140 years for the murder of eight women in the Donnybrook area in 1995.
